newsitem.title: USA: Herman urges flexibility, compromise in UPS strike.
newsitem.headline: Herman urges flexibility, compromise in UPS strike.

text.p: Labour Secretary Alexis Herman on Monday met separately with both sides in the Teamsters strike against the United Parcel Service, calling for greater flexibility and a sense of compromise.

"I made it clear that everyone involved must show greater flexibility and a willingness to compromise," she said in a statement after hours of meetings. But UPS chief negotiator Dave Murray said after meeting with her that the company would not alter its offer for a new contract.
Herman said she had discussed in detail with both sides what it would take to get them back to the bargaining table.
She added the talks "were serious and each side will be conferring with its representatives and will get back to me about next steps."
Herman described the two sets of discussions as "candid, wide-ranging and useful."
The eight-day strike by 184,000 Teamsters has curtailed delivery of the 12 million packages a day usually handled by UPS.
